entities.name: Jetmir
entities.description: A cat demon, founder and crime-lord boss of the Cabaretti family in New Capenna and adoptive father of Jinnie Fay.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: One of New Capenna's five crime families, founded and led by Jetmir.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The art-deco city plane where Jetmir rules the Cabaretti.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: The power source of New Capenna that Jetmir kept flowing.

entities.name: The Adversary
entities.description: The foe whose agents gravely wounded Jetmir at the Crescendo.

entities.name: Crescendo
entities.description: A celebration at which Jetmir was gravely wounded.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Jetmir complained about the use of his Halo reserves.

events.summary: At the Crescendo celebration, Jetmir is gravely wounded by agents of the Adversary and tended to by his adopted daughter in an Obscura safehouse.
events.quote: Jetmir was gravely wounded by agents of the Adversary

events.summary: By the New Phyrexian Invasion, Jetmir has recovered and complains about use of his Halo reserves against the invaders.
events.quote: he seemed to have recovered, complaining about the use of his Halo reserves against the invaders
